as_told.title: Henri Coanda's saucer patent and work with the Nazis and Avrocar

plain: A Romanian engineer named Henri Coanda is said to have held the first patent on a flying saucer, filed in 1936, and later to have worked with the Nazis after they took control of his world. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source beyond the patent. In one episode he gives the date as 1936, and in another he places it around 1937 and ties Coanda's ideas to the Avrocar, a saucer-shaped aircraft, rather than to Project Y, a later saucer-shaped aircraft project. If true, it would mean serious saucer designs were on paper more than a decade before the famous UFO reports of the late 1940s.
